The '''Kul Tiran Exploratory Fleet''' is a group of Kul Tiran sailors and marines stranded on [[Lapidis Isle]]. Remnants of Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's exploratory fleet, these few survivors that have not been killed by the Horde eke out a dangerous existence.
